font.reason: The card is a neutral product/UI skeleton. Vazirmatn is a loaded variable Persian UI sans with dependable glyph coverage and real weight variation; it is appropriate for any future Persian chrome without fallback shaping or fake bold.

text.notes: GrayHome is made only of geometric placeholder bars, dots, cards and lines. No JSX text, SVG text, number label, URL, code island, or baked-in foreign-language copy appears on screen.

rtlDecisions.what: GrayHome sidebar and main content columns
rtlDecisions.action: Moved the sidebar to the right with row-reverse; used a start-side divider on the sidebar and explicit RTL direction inside both regions.
rtlDecisions.why: The sidebar is a reading/layout rail, so Persian UI start belongs on the right. The visual width and all vertical spacing remain unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: Sidebar rows and main content rows
rtlDecisions.action: Kept physical dimensions but let rows inherit RTL order; mirrored the search icon/line pair and the trailing avatar group with logical margin.
rtlDecisions.why: These are UI reading-order relationships, not physical-world motion. The first control/marker therefore remains at the Persian start edge.

rtlDecisions.action: Changed FRAME_D start from the left midpoint to the right midpoint while preserving the two-headed strokeDasharray, path length, easing and frame range.
rtlDecisions.why: The frame is a UI entrance announcing the reading-start panel edge; its directional reveal carries layout meaning and must mirror in RTL.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored perspectiveOrigin horizontally and negated rotateY/rotateZ signs; kept rotateX, scale, fall physics and all interpolation frames unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The horizontal perspective bias is part of the directional composition of the UI frame. Vertical depth/settling is physical and remains the same.

rtlDecisions.what: Panel cold overlay and rim glow
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the diagonal gradient angle and swapped the horizontal box-shadow offsets; kept vertical offsets, blur, opacity and colors unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The gradient/shadow bias implies the same horizontal light/composition direction as the mirrored frame and must remain balanced after the sidebar moves.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the generated field, seed 20260718, phase, periods and skew values unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: It is abstract physical atmosphere with no text or reading-order semantics; mirroring it would change the authored random composition unnecessarily.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept horizontal/vertical lift, shadow offset, blur and easing unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: This is physical 3D elevation and gravity-like settling, not reading direction. The motion beats must match the source exactly.

rasterHandling.action: No raster or video assets exist in this card; no blur, replacement, regeneration, or mirroring was necessary.
